Appendix III
LIST OF PĀÑCARĀTRA
TEXTS
(in Hayaśīrṣa-saṁhitā)

1. Hayaśīrṣa-samhitā
2. Trailokya-mohana-saṁhitā
3. Vaibhava-samhitā
4. Paushkara-samhitā
5. Nāradīya-samhitā
6. Prahlāda-samhitā
7. Gālava-samhitā
8. Śrī-Praśna-samhitā
9. Śāṇḍilya-samhitā
10. Īśvara-samhitā
11. Sāttvata-samhitā
12. Vāśiṣṭha-samhitā
13. Śaunakīya-samhitā
14. Nārāyaṇa-saṁhitā
15. Jñānārṇava-samhitā
16. Svāyambhuva-samhitā
17. Kāpila-samhitā

18. Vihagendra-samhitā
19. Ātreya-samhitā
20. Nārasimha-samhitā
21. Ānanda-samhitā
22. Aruṇa-samhitā
23. Bodhāyana-samhitā
24. Viśvāvatāra-samhitā
25. Aṣṭākṣara-vidhāna-saṁhitā
26. Bhāgavata-samhitā
27. Śiva-samhitā
28. Viṣṇu-samhitā
29. Pādmodbhava-samhitā
30. Purāṇa-samhitā
31. Varāha-samhitā
32. Sāmānya-samhitā
33. Brahma-samhitā
34. Parama-samhitā
summary: Appendix III provides a numbered list of 34 Pāñcarātra texts. It is specified that this list is found within another text, the Hayaśīrṣa-saṁhitā, which is itself the first item on the list. The list is presented in two columns and contains the names of various saṁhitās, which are important scriptures in the Pāñcarātra tradition of Vaishnavism.
purpose: The purpose of this appendix is to serve as a bibliographic reference, cataloging a specific set of Pāñcarātra texts as enumerated in the Hayaśīrṣa-saṁhitā. This provides readers and researchers with a clear, consolidated list of these scriptures.
key_information: The appendix contains a list of 34 Pāñcarātra texts.
The source for this list is cited as the Hayaśīrṣa-saṁhitā.
The texts are all named with the suffix '-saṁhitā', indicating they are compilations or collections of knowledge within the tradition.
The list includes prominent texts such as Hayaśīrṣa-saṁhitā, Nāradīya-samhitā, and Sāttvata-samhitā.

tables_and_data.description: A two-column, numbered list of Pāñcarātra texts.
tables_and_data.data_summary: The list enumerates 34 texts, from 1 (Hayaśīrṣa-samhitā) to 34 (Parama-samhitā). Items 1-17 are in the left column, and items 18-34 are in the right column.

references_to_chapters: No explicit references to other chapters are present in the text.
